text: Which energy regeneration system is described as the most common, providing roughly 4 hours of ATP regeneration in cell-free reactions?
explanation: Creatine phosphate/creatine kinase (CP/CK) is identified as the most common energy regeneration system, typically sustaining reactions for about 4 hours. PEP is described as clean but expensive, maltose/maltodextrin supports longer but more complex reactions, and oxidative phosphorylation with membranes is renewable yet technically demanding -- none of these is labeled the most common choice.
